[4] (ran5_tdoc_chunks R5-252767, sim=0.5421)
In RAN2, for the NR ASN.1 review it was discussed whether to embed the ASN.1 definitions into the markdown files. While it would be possible, that approach would prohibit the use of advanced editors offering highlighting/formatting, auto-completion, context sensitive search and detection of syntax errors. Instead, current proposal is that the ASN.1 code should be stored in separate asn-files in the same git project as the MD files. In the NR RRC specification, the field descriptions were maintained in tables separately from the actual ASN.1 code. This made it inconvenient to toggle between the ASN.1 definition and the corresponding field descriptions especially for large IE with many fields.
